0.long_answer: In the only reported case of Cortes Lacassie syndrome, the infant experienced acute liver failure. The literature on hepatic phenotypes in NBAS‐associated disease notes that liver transplantation effectively prevents the progression of acute liver failure, suggesting that this specific condition might have been prevented from worsening. Dialysis may also play a role in managing complications, but the primary intervention noted is the use of liver transplantation to arrest acute liver failure.
